It features procedurally generated floors, melee combat, enemy types and a final warden, leveling, potions, shards, collectible relics, dash and responsive touch controls. Verified the game in-browser and captured a screenshot at `screenshots/ashen.jpg`.

Assumption: the run is designed as a three-floor descent, with a boss encounter on the final floor.
